title: Mina's Last Jump
subtitle: The boundary stayed when screen time ended
description: The game was one jump from saving when the timer chimed. Mina is not ready to stop. Alex keeps the screen-time limit, repairs an abrupt command and offers a small piece of control inside a non-negotiable ending. The final page gives parents, carers and educators a key message and practical ideas for shared discussion and rehearsal.
